questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.1 Describe the interconnected nature of the service value chain and how this supports value streams
questions.keyword: interconnected nature of the service value chain
questions.text: Which statement best describes the service value chain?

answers.text: An operating model for the creation, delivery, and continual improvement of services
A fixed sequence of activities that every value stream must follow exactly
A list of only technical support practices
A replacement for the guiding principles and practices

explanations.a: The service value chain is the central operating model for creating, delivering, and continually improving services. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Exam wording 141: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, the service value chain is flexible; value streams can use activities in different patterns.
explanations.c: Value-stream clue 141: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, the service value chain is broader than technical support and works across the service value system.
explanations.d: Input-output clue 141: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, the service value chain works with guiding principles and practices rather than replacing them.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.1 Describe the interconnected nature of the service value chain and how this supports value streams
questions.keyword: interconnected nature of the service value chain
questions.text: How do service value chain activities support value streams?

answers.text: They are used only when a new service is created
They can be combined in different ways to create value streams for specific situations
They remove the need to understand demand
They must always be used once each in the same order

explanations.a: Improvement clue 142: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, value streams can support new, changed, and existing services.
explanations.b: Value streams use service value chain activities in patterns that fit the required outcome. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Transition clue 142: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, value streams should be shaped by demand, opportunity, and intended value.
explanations.d: Build clue 142: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, service value chain activities are not a mandatory linear sequence.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.1 Describe the interconnected nature of the service value chain and how this supports value streams
questions.keyword: interconnected nature of the service value chain
questions.text: Identify the missing word(s): The relevant service value chain activity or concept is [?]. Which statement about the service value chain activities is CORRECT?

answers.text: The activities are the same as the four dimensions
Each activity works independently with no shared inputs or outputs
Each activity transforms inputs into outputs and can receive or provide work to other activities
The activities apply only to service providers that use automation

explanations.a: Usage clue 143: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, the service value chain activities and four dimensions are different ITIL concepts.
explanations.b: Syllabus match 143: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, the activities are interconnected and support one another.
explanations.c: The activities are interconnected and exchange inputs and outputs to enable value creation. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Scenario clue 143: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, the activities apply regardless of whether work is manual, automated, or mixed.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.1 Describe the interconnected nature of the service value chain and how this supports value streams
questions.keyword: interconnected nature of the service value chain
questions.text: A team maps how demand becomes value through several connected activities. Which concept are they applying?

answers.text: A warranty target only
A single supplier contract
A service relationship role definition
A value stream using service value chain activities

explanations.a: Language clue 144: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, warranty concerns fitness for use and does not map the end-to-end flow of work.
explanations.b: Practice logic 144: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, a supplier contract may support a value stream, but it is not the value stream itself.
explanations.c: Learning outcome clue 144: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, roles may be involved, but the connected activity flow is a value stream.
explanations.d: A value stream describes how activities combine to create value for a specific scenario. This is the correct answer.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.1 Describe the interconnected nature of the service value chain and how this supports value streams
questions.keyword: interconnected nature of the service value chain
questions.text: Which statement about interconnected nature of the service value chain is CORRECT?

answers.text: Different types of demand and opportunity require different combinations of activities
Because service providers should avoid planning work
Because continual improvement is outside the service value system
Because the activities are unrelated to one another

explanations.a: The service value chain is flexible so organizations can create value streams suited to different needs. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Exam wording 145: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, planning remains a service value chain activity.
explanations.c: Value-stream clue 145: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, continual improvement is a component of the service value system and influences the value chain.
explanations.d: Input-output clue 145: regarding interconnected nature of the service value chain, the activities are interconnected even though they are not a rigid sequence.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.2 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: plan
questions.text: Which output is commonly associated with the plan activity?

answers.text: User support interactions
Strategic, tactical, and operational plans or portfolio decisions
Resolved incidents from live services
New or changed service components

explanations.a: Improvement clue 146: regarding plan, support interactions are more closely connected with deliver and support.
explanations.b: Plan produces direction and plans that guide service value chain work. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Transition clue 146: regarding plan, incident resolution is more closely associated with deliver and support.
explanations.d: Build clue 146: regarding plan, components are produced or obtained through obtain/build.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.2 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: plan
questions.text: What is the purpose of the plan activity in the service value chain?

answers.text: To make services available for use by users
To obtain service components from suppliers or build them internally
To ensure a shared understanding of the vision, current status, and improvement direction for all four dimensions and all products and services
To provide a channel for stakeholder communication

explanations.a: Usage clue 147: regarding plan, making services available is associated more directly with design and transition and deliver and support work.
explanations.b: Syllabus match 147: regarding plan, obtaining or building components belongs to the obtain/build activity.
explanations.c: Plan ensures shared understanding of direction, status, and improvement across the organization. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Scenario clue 147: regarding plan, stakeholder interaction is the main focus of engage.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.2 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: plan
questions.text: A leadership team defines service management goals and direction across products and services. Which service value chain activity is most relevant?

answers.text: Obtain/build
Deliver and support
Engage
Plan

explanations.a: Language clue 148: regarding plan, obtain/build focuses on ensuring service components are available when needed.
explanations.b: Practice logic 148: regarding plan, deliver and support focuses on delivering and supporting services according to specifications.
explanations.c: Learning outcome clue 148: regarding plan, engage focuses on understanding stakeholder needs and maintaining relationships.
explanations.d: Plan supports shared understanding of vision, status, objectives, and improvement direction. This is the correct answer.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.3 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: improve
questions.text: Identify the missing word(s): The relevant service value chain activity or concept is [?]. Which statement about improve is CORRECT?

answers.text: It applies to every service value chain activity, not just to a separate improvement team
It is limited to technology upgrades
It is used only after a major incident
It stops once a service is live

explanations.a: Improve is part of the service value chain and can influence all activities and dimensions. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Exam wording 149: regarding improve, improvement can involve people, suppliers, processes, information, and technology.
explanations.c: Value-stream clue 149: regarding improve, improvements can be proactive, reactive, small, or large.
explanations.d: Input-output clue 149: regarding improve, continual improvement continues throughout the service lifecycle.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.3 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: improve
questions.text: What is the purpose of the improve activity in the service value chain?

answers.text: To receive stakeholder demand and convert it into requirements
To ensure continual improvement of products, services, and practices across all value chain activities and the four dimensions
To build every service component used by the organization
To authorize budget for service consumption

explanations.a: Enhancement-related check 150: regarding improve, understanding stakeholder demand is mainly part of engage.
explanations.b: Improve ensures continual improvement across services, practices, activities, and dimensions. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Transition clue 150: regarding improve, building components belongs to obtain/build.
explanations.d: Build clue 150: regarding improve, budget authorization is associated with the sponsor role, not the improve activity.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.3 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: improve
questions.text: Which statement about improve is CORRECT?

answers.text: Design and transition
Engage
Improve
Plan

explanations.a: Usage clue 151: regarding improve, design and transition can implement changes, but the improvement intent is the main clue.
explanations.b: Syllabus match 151: regarding improve, engage may gather feedback, but reducing delays through improvement is aligned with improve.
explanations.c: Improve supports continual improvement based on feedback, measurement, and changing needs. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Scenario clue 151: regarding improve, plan sets direction, but the described action is an improvement activity.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.4 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: engage
questions.text: Which outcome is expected from the engage activity?

answers.text: A rigid sequence for every value stream
A guarantee that no future changes will be needed
A completed service component ready for deployment
Clear stakeholder requirements, requests, feedback, and relationship information

explanations.a: Language clue 152: regarding engage, engage does not define one fixed sequence for all value streams.
explanations.b: Practice logic 152: regarding engage, engagement can reveal changing needs rather than prevent change.
explanations.c: Learning outcome clue 152: regarding engage, built or obtained components are associated with obtain/build.
explanations.d: Engage produces and uses stakeholder information needed by other value chain activities. This is the correct answer.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.4 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: engage
questions.text: What is the purpose of the engage activity in the service value chain?

answers.text: To provide a good understanding of stakeholder needs, transparency, continual engagement, and good relationships
To ensure components are available when and where needed
To deliver services according to agreed specifications
To define the organization’s overall vision and status

explanations.a: Engage focuses on stakeholder needs, transparency, communication, and relationships. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Exam wording 153: regarding engage, component availability is the purpose of obtain/build.
explanations.c: Value-stream clue 153: regarding engage, delivering and supporting services is the purpose of deliver and support.
explanations.d: Input-output clue 153: regarding engage, shared vision and direction are associated with plan.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.4 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: engage
questions.text: A service provider gathers customer feedback and clarifies expectations before defining requirements. Which activity is most relevant?

answers.text: Improve
Engage
Deliver and support
Obtain/build

explanations.a: Improvement clue 154: regarding engage, feedback may support improvement, but the described stakeholder interaction is engage.
explanations.b: Engage helps the organization understand stakeholder needs and maintain relationships. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Transition clue 154: regarding engage, deliver and support concerns live delivery and support according to specifications.
explanations.d: Build clue 154: regarding engage, obtain/build is about service components, not primarily stakeholder understanding.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.5 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: design and transition
questions.text: Identify the missing word(s): The relevant service value chain activity or concept is [?]. What is the purpose of the design and transition activity?

answers.text: To maintain supplier contracts only
To provide user support for live services
To ensure products and services continually meet stakeholder expectations for quality, costs, and time to market
To create shared understanding of organizational strategy

explanations.a: Usage clue 155: regarding design and transition, supplier relationships can contribute, but design and transition is broader than contracts.
explanations.b: Syllabus match 155: regarding design and transition, providing support for live services belongs mainly to deliver and support.
explanations.c: Design and transition ensures services and products meet stakeholder expectations for quality, cost, and timing. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Scenario clue 155: regarding design and transition, shared strategy and direction are associated with plan.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.5 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: design and transition
questions.text: A service is being prepared for release so it will meet agreed quality and time-to-market expectations. Which activity is most relevant?

answers.text: Engage
Plan
Deliver and support
Design and transition

explanations.a: Language clue 156: regarding design and transition, engage helps understand stakeholder needs, but preparing a service for release is design and transition.
explanations.b: Practice logic 156: regarding design and transition, plan sets direction, but transition readiness belongs more directly to design and transition.
explanations.c: Learning outcome clue 156: regarding design and transition, deliver and support handles live service delivery and support after transition.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.6 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: obtain/build
questions.text: Which statement about obtain/build is CORRECT?

answers.text: To ensure service components are available when and where they are needed and meet agreed specifications
To deliver and support live services according to agreed specifications
To provide overall direction and shared understanding
To understand stakeholder needs and maintain relationships

explanations.a: Obtain/build ensures service components are available and meet agreed specifications. This is the correct answer.

explanations.c: Value-stream clue 157: regarding obtain/build, overall direction and shared understanding are part of plan.
explanations.d: Input-output clue 157: regarding obtain/build, stakeholder understanding and relationships are part of engage.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.6 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: obtain/build
questions.text: A team develops a new integration and purchases a monitoring tool needed for a service. Which activity is most relevant?

answers.text: Plan
Obtain/build
Improve
Engage

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.7 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: deliver and support
questions.text: What is the purpose of the deliver and support activity?

answers.text: To obtain service components from internal or external sources
To define the shared organizational vision
To ensure services are delivered and supported according to agreed specifications and stakeholder expectations
To provide only stakeholder relationship management

explanations.a: Usage clue 159: regarding deliver and support, obtaining components belongs to obtain/build.
explanations.b: Syllabus match 159: regarding deliver and support, shared vision is associated with plan.

questions.name: Understand the activities of the service value chain, and how they interconnect
questions.objective: 5.7 Describe the purpose of the service value chain activity: deliver and support
questions.text: A service desk resolves user requests and supports a live service against agreed expectations. Which activity is most relevant?

answers.text: Plan
Obtain/build
Design and transition
Deliver and support

explanations.a: Language clue 160: regarding deliver and support, plan provides direction but does not directly resolve user requests.
explanations.b: Practice logic 160: regarding deliver and support, obtain/build ensures components are available, while the described work is service support.
explanations.c: Learning outcome clue 160: regarding deliver and support, design and transition prepares new or changed services, while the question describes live support.
